COALESCE(cfd.hs_code, '') AS item_hs_code , CASE WHEN cfd.outarea_qty = 0 AND cfd.inarea_qty > 0 THEN 'KR' ELSE 'NON-KR' END AS origin , cfd.requirement_qty AS item_requirement_qty , CASE WHEN cfd.requirement_qty = 0 THEN NULL ELSE cfd.input_amount / cfd.requirement_qty END AS item_input_price , cfd.input_amount AS item_input_amount , CASE WHEN cfd.inarea_qty > 0 THEN COALESCE( ( SELECT LPAD(eccm.coo_certify_no, 50, ' ') || LPAD(eccm.vendor_code, 20, ' ') || LPAD(eccm.division_code, 20, ' ') FROM ext_coo_certify_dtl eccd INNER JOIN ext_coo_certify_mst eccm ON eccm.coo_certify_no = eccd.coo_certify_no AND eccm.vendor_code = eccd.vendor_code AND eccm.division_code = eccd.division_code AND eccm.company_code = eccd.company_code AND eccm.submit_status = '4' INNER JOIN coo_division_v cd ON cd.division_code = eccd.division_code AND cd.company_code = eccd.company_code LEFT OUTER JOIN po_ledger pl ON pl.vendor_code = eccd.vendor_code AND pl.division_code = CASE WHEN eccd.apply_type = 'M' THEN cd.coo_receipt_division_code WHEN eccd.apply_type = 'A' THEN pl.division_code ELSE pl.division_code END AND pl.company_code = cd.company_code AND pl.item_code = eccd.item_code AND 1 = CASE WHEN eccm.coo_certify_type = 'N' AND eccd.warehousing_no = pl.warehousing_no AND eccd.warehousing_seq = pl.seq THEN 1 WHEN eccm.coo_certify_type = 'C' AND eccd.apply_date <= pl.warehousing_date AND eccd.end_date >= pl.warehousing_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE eccd.coo_yn = 'Y' AND eccd.item_code = cfd.item_code AND eccd.company_code = cfd.company_code AND eccd.division_code = cfd.division_code AND eccd.fta_code = cfd.fta_code AND 1 = CASE WHEN eccm.coo_certify_type = 'C' AND ccld.issue_date >= eccd.apply_date AND ccld.issue_date <= eccd.end_date THEN 1 WHEN eccm.coo_certify_type = 'N' AND pl.warehousing_no IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT LPAD(eccm.coo_certify_no, 50, ' ') || LPAD(eccm.vendor_code, 20, ' ') || LPAD(eccm.division_code, 20, ' ') FROM ext_coo_certify_dtl eccd INNER JOIN ext_coo_certify_mst eccm ON eccm.coo_certify_no = eccd.coo_certify_no AND eccm.vendor_code = eccd.vendor_code AND eccm.division_code = eccd.division_code AND eccm.company_code = eccd.company_code AND eccm.submit_status = '4' INNER JOIN coo_division_v cd ON cd.division_code = eccd.division_code AND cd.company_code = eccd.company_code LEFT OUTER JOIN po_ledger pl ON pl.vendor_code = eccd.vendor_code AND pl.division_code = CASE WHEN eccd.apply_type = 'M' THEN cd.coo_receipt_division_code WHEN eccd.apply_type = 'A' THEN pl.division_code ELSE pl.division_code END AND pl.company_code = cd.company_code AND pl.item_code = eccd.item_code AND 1 = CASE WHEN eccm.coo_certify_type = 'N' AND eccd.warehousing_no = pl.warehousing_no AND eccd.warehousing_seq = pl.seq THEN 1 WHEN eccm.coo_certify_type = 'C' AND eccd.apply_date <= pl.warehousing_date AND eccd.end_date >= pl.warehousing_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE eccd.coo_yn = 'Y' AND eccd.item_code = cfd.item_code AND eccd.company_code = cfd.company_code AND eccd.fta_code = cfd.fta_code AND 1 = CASE WHEN eccm.coo_certify_type = 'C' AND ccld.issue_date >= eccd.apply_date AND ccld.issue_date <= eccd.end_date THEN 1 WHEN eccm.coo_certify_type = 'N' AND pl.warehousing_no IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END LIMIT 1 ) ) ELSE COALESCE( ( SELECT LPAD('', 50, ' ') || LPAD(pl.vendor_code, 20, ' ') || LPAD(pl.division_code, 20, ' ') FROM po_ledger pl WHERE pl.warehousing_date <= ccld.issue_date AND pl.company_code = cfd.company_code AND pl.item_code = cfd.item_code ORDER BY pl.warehousing_date DESC LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT LPAD('', 50, ' ') || LPAD(pl.vendor_code, 20, ' ') || LPAD(pl.division_code, 20, ' ') FROM po_ledger pl WHERE pl.warehousing_date BETWEEN ccld.apply_date AND ccld.end_date AND pl.company_code = cfd.company_code AND pl.item_code = cfd.item_code ORDER BY pl.warehousing_date DESC LIMIT 1 ) ) END AS ext_coo_key FROM coo_certify_ledger ccl INNER JOIN coo_certify_ledger_dtl ccld ON ccld.coo_certify_no = ccl.coo_certify_no AND ccld.division_code = ccl.division_code AND ccld.company_code = ccl.company_code INNER JOIN coo_fcr_mst cfm ON cfm.coo_certify_no = ccld.coo_certify_no AND cfm.sales_no = ccld.sales_no AND cfm.sales_seq = ccld.sales_seq AND cfm.fta_code = ccld.fta_code AND cfm.division_code = ccld.division_code AND cfm.company_code = ccld.company_code INNER JOIN coo_fcr_dtl cfd ON cfd.coo_certify_no = cfm.coo_certify_no AND cfd.sales_no = cfm.sales_no AND cfd.sales_seq = cfm.sales_seq AND cfd.fta_code = cfm.fta_code AND cfd.division_code = cfm.division_code AND cfd.company_code = cfm.company_code INNER JOIN sales_dtl sd ON sd.sales_no = ccld.sales_no AND sd.sales_seq = ccld.sales_seq AND sd.division_code = ccld.division_code AND sd.company_code = ccld.company_code WHERE ccl.coo_certify_no = #{coo_certify_no} AND ccl.division_code = #{division_code} AND ccld.product_code = #{product_code} AND ccld.fta_code = #{fta_code} AND ccld.sales_no = #{sales_no} AND ccld.sales_seq = #{sales_seq}::bigint ) ccld LEFT OUTER JOIN item_mst im ON im.item_code = ccld.product_code AND im.company_code = ccld.company_code LEFT OUTER JOIN item_mst im2 ON im2.item_code = ccld.item_code AND im2.company_code = ccld.company_code LEFT OUTER JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_code = LTRIM(SUBSTR(ccld.ext_coo_key, 51, 20)) AND v.company_code = ccld.company_code LEFT OUTER JOIN division d ON d.division_code = LTRIM(SUBSTR(ccld.ext_coo_key, 71, 50)) AND d.company_code = ccld.company_code INNER JOIN fta_master fm ON fm.fta_code = ccld.fta_code AND fm.company_code = ccld.company_code AND fm.delete_yn <> 'Y' ORDER BY ccld.item_input_amount DESC

SELECT im.item_code AS item_code , im.item_name AS item_name , v.vendor_code AS vendor_code , v.vendor_name AS vendor_name , ecm.coo_certify_no AS coo_certify_no , ecf.file_name AS file_name , ecf.origin_file_name AS origin_file_name , ecf.file_path AS file_path , ecf.file_seq AS file_seq , ecm.division_code AS division_code , ecm.submit_status AS submit_status FROM coo_certify_ledger ccl INNER JOIN coo_certify_ledger_dtl cld ON cld.coo_certify_no = ccl.coo_certify_no AND cld.division_code = ccl.division_code AND cld.company_code = ccl.company_code INNER JOIN sales_mst sm ON sm.sales_no = cld.sales_no AND sm.division_code = cld.division_code AND sm.company_code = cld.company_code INNER JOIN coo_fcr_mst fm ON fm.coo_certify_no = cld.coo_certify_no AND fm.sales_no = cld.sales_no AND fm.sales_seq = cld.sales_seq AND fm.division_code = cld.division_code AND fm.company_code = cld.company_code AND fm.fta_code = cld.fta_code INNER JOIN coo_fcr_dtl fd ON fd.coo_certify_no = fm.coo_certify_no AND fd.sales_no = fm.sales_no AND fd.sales_seq = fm.sales_seq AND fd.division_code = fm.division_code AND fd.company_code = fm.company_code AND fd.fta_code = fm.fta_code INNER JOIN material_inv_bal mib ON mib.item_code = fd.item_code AND mib.company_code = fm.company_code AND mib.yyyymm = ( SELECT MAX(mib2.yyyymm) FROM material_inv_bal mib2 WHERE mib2.item_code = fd.item_code AND mib2.division_code = mib.division_code AND mib2.company_code = fm.company_code AND mib2.yyyymm <= substring(sm.invoice_date, 1, 6) AND (mib2.issue_qty + mib2.extra_issue_qty) > 0 ) INNER JOIN po_ledger pl ON pl.item_code = mib.item_code AND pl.company_code = mib.company_code AND pl.warehousing_date BETWEEN CASE WHEN (coalesce(mib.initial_qty, 0) = 0 AND coalesce(mib.input_qty, 0) > 0) OR (coalesce(mib.initial_qty, 0) > 0 AND coalesce(mib.input_qty, 0) > 0) THEN to_char(to_date(mib.yyyymm, 'yyyymm'), 'yyyymm') || '01' WHEN coalesce(mib.initial_qty, 0) > 0 AND coalesce(mib.input_qty, 0) = 0 THEN to_char( to_date(mib.yyyymm, 'yyyymm') - (interval '1 month' * greatest(coalesce(mib.aging_period, 0), 0)), 'yyyymmdd' ) END AND CASE WHEN (coalesce(mib.initial_qty, 0) = 0 AND coalesce(mib.input_qty, 0) > 0) OR (coalesce(mib.initial_qty, 0) > 0 AND coalesce(mib.input_qty, 0) > 0) THEN to_char( (date_trunc('month', to_date(mib.yyyymm, 'yyyymm')) + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date, 'yyyymmdd' ) WHEN coalesce(mib.initial_qty, 0) > 0 AND coalesce(mib.input_qty, 0) = 0 THEN to_char( (date_trunc( 'month', to_date(mib.yyyymm, 'yyyymm') - (interval '1 month' * greatest(coalesce(mib.aging_period, 0), 0)) ) + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date, 'yyyymmdd' ) END INNER JOIN coo_division_v d ON d.division_code = pl.division_code AND d.company_code = pl.company_code INNER JOIN ext_coo_certify_dtl ecd ON ecd.item_code = pl.item_code AND ecd.company_code = pl.company_code AND ecd.vendor_code = pl.vendor_code AND ecd.division_code = CASE WHEN ecd.apply_type = 'A' THEN ecd.division_code ELSE d.coo_receipt_division_code END INNER JOIN ext_coo_certify_mst ecm ON ecm.coo_certify_no = ecd.coo_certify_no AND ecm.vendor_code = ecd.vendor_code AND ecm.company_code = ecd.company_code AND ecm.division_code = ecd.division_code AND ecm.submit_status = '4' AND ( (ecm.coo_certify_type = 'C' AND pl.warehousing_date BETWEEN ecd.apply_date AND ecd.end_date) OR (ecm.coo_certify_type = 'N' AND pl.warehousing_no = ecd.warehousing_no AND pl.seq = ecd.warehousing_seq) ) INNER JOIN ext_coo_certify_file ecf ON ecf.coo_certify_no = ecm.coo_certify_no AND ecf.vendor_code = ecm.vendor_code AND ecf.division_code = ecm.division_code AND ecf.company_code = ecm.company_code INNER JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_code = ecm.vendor_code AND v.company_code = ecm.company_code INNER JOIN item_mst im ON im.item_code = pl.item_code AND im.company_code = pl.company_code WHERE ccl.coo_certify_no = #{coo_certify_no} AND ccl.division_code = #{division_code} AND ccl.company_code = #{company_code} AND cld.sales_no = #{sales_no} AND cld.sales_seq = CAST(#{sales_seq} AS bigint) AND cld.fta_code = #{fta_code} GROUP BY im.item_code , im.item_name , v.vendor_code , v.vendor_name , ecm.coo_certify_no , ecf.file_name , ecf.origin_file_name , ecf.file_path , ecf.file_seq , ecm.division_code , ecm.submit_status
